source_policy: One predeclared camera request; retain any source failure or truncated session. The existing worker permits three consecutive reconnect attempts. Do not replace failed observations silently.
runtime: Native streaming worker; CPUExecutionProvider; two CPU threads; no VLM during acquisition

inference.tracker_scope: Persistent within uninterrupted observation; reset after sampled-frame gaps above one second

clock: Local decoder arrival/elapsed clock, not verified camera sensor timestamps; separate from video-PTS studies
endpoints: Completion or retained failure, actual elapsed observation and initialization time
Sampled/decoded frames, reconnect attempts, gaps and context resets
Median/p95 sampled-frame processing and arrival-to-decision latency
Unassigned candidate alert count and eligible acquisition intervals at the existing one-second gap limit
Source, model, implementation, report, decisions and media hashes
label_policy: All observations and alerts remain UNASSIGNED until independent review. Do not calculate accuracy, recall, false-alarm rates or reviewed-normal camera-hours from this runtime session.
media_policy: Keep camera video and screenshots local; publish numerical summaries and provenance without redistributing footage unless reuse terms are separately verified.
